newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Powerful earthquake rocks northern Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Powerful earthquake rocks northern Colombia.

text.p: A powerful earthquake rocked northern Colombia on Friday but there were no immediate reports of injuries or serious damage, authorities said.

Spokesmen for the national seismological institute said the quake, which registered 5.8 on the Richter scale, struck at about 12:29 P.M. EST (1729 GMT) and was centred near the city of Bucaramanga in northern Santander province.

It was powerful enough to cause considerable damage in a populated area, according to the seismological institute. But the quake's potential to wreak harm was limited by the fact that it occurred nearly 100 miles (150 km) beneath the earth's surface.
